scripts.kill-ports: bash -lc 'for port in 8780 5180 8080; do lsof -ti :"$port"; done | xargs kill 2>/dev/null || true; echo "Ports cleared"'
scripts.dev: pnpm run kill-ports && concurrently -n api,frontend,landing -c green,blue,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "pnpm run -F=api dev" "pnpm run -F=frontend dev" "pnpm run -F=landing dev"
scripts.dev:telegram: pnpm run kill-ports && concurrently -n api,frontend,tunnel -c green,blue,yellow --kill-others-on-fail "pnpm run -F=api dev" "pnpm run -F=frontend dev" "pnpm run -F=api tunnel"
